newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toa Oil to shut 65,000 bpd topper on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Toa Oil to shut 65,000 bpd topper on Thursday.

text.p: Toa Oil Co Ltd said on Wednesday it will close its 65,000 barrel-per-day crude distillation unit at its Kawasaki plant, near Tokyo, on Thursday for routine maintenance.
The refiner, affiliated with Showa Shell Sekiyu KK, plans to bring the topper back on line on May 7, a Toa spokesman said.
The Kawasaki plant, equipped with several desulphurisation units, mainly processes high sulphur crude oil, he added.
